summary: A petitioner finishes a round of door knocking without having a conversation worth recounting.
realLife: An AP reporter walked with county party chair Liz Purvis in Oxford, North Carolina. Purvis knocked at five homes before anyone answered her.
inGame: The campaign petition and signature-retention mechanics record activity independently of dialogue.

turns.what: A resident calls headquarters after finding the canvasser's card.
turns.pulledBy: The resident returned home after the shift ended.
turns.writesBack: A later callback is linked to the unanswered visit.

turns.what: When the volunteer turns in a blank signature sheet, the organizer asks which houses still need a visit.
turns.pulledBy: The route card distinguishes unanswered doors from residents who declined to sign.
turns.writesBack: The organizer copies the unanswered addresses to the next shift’s route.
